summary.text: Carolyn Caiharr is a Republican state representative from Wyandotte County who has represented Kansas House District 33 since being appointed in 2025 and is seeking election to a full term on November 3, 2026. She is the mayor of Edwardsville and a Realtor, and in a Ballotpedia survey she named property tax relief as her primary focus.

paragraphs.text: Caiharr was appointed to the Kansas House on August 16, 2025, by Republican precinct committee members from Wyandotte County, to replace former Representative Mike Thompson; Ballotpedia lists her as taking office on September 5, 2025.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Caiharr described herself as a lifelong Wyandotte County resident and a graduate of Turner High School in Kansas City, Kansas.
She said she has been the mayor of Edwardsville since 2022 and served on the Edwardsville City Council for four years before that.
She said her campaign messages are property tax relief, public safety, and fiscal accountability, and that she is also a Realtor.
